//go:build linux

// Package fixture holds one of every comment shape Go writes. It is stored as
// .go.txt so that neither cargo nor go build picks it up.
package fixture

import "strings"

// Find looks the user up in the cache.
//
// The example below is indented, which is the only thing that says it is one:
//
//	user, err := Find(id)
//	if err != nil {
//		return err
//	}
//
// Anything after it is prose again.
func Find(id uint64) string {
	// The // in the URL below is not a comment. It sits inside a string
	// literal, and Tree-sitter leaves it there instead of guessing from the
	// raw text.
	endpoint := "https://example.com/users" // Trailing note.

	/*
		This block comment is indented by the file rather than by its writer,
		and its prose has to stay prose.
	*/
	return strings.TrimSpace(endpoint)
}

// Order applies the rules in this order:
//
//   - Anything else comes before RC4
//   - ECDHE comes before anything else
//
// A list is written indented and is still a list.
func Order() {}

/*
Sum adds two numbers. This comment carries no stars, and its example is
indented with spaces:

    total := Sum(1, 2)

See [strings.TrimSpace] for the shape of a doc link.
*/
func Sum(a, b int) int { return a + b }

// 日本語のコメントも字下げされた例を持てる:
//
//	fmt.Println("こんにちは")
func Greet() {}
